detailed_descriptions.en: Sparedevil is an arcade FPS with the graphic charm of classic '90s bowling alley animations. This single-player skirmish is all about skill, strategy, and speed as you aim to dominate the leaderboard and earn the crown as the Kingpin of Hell’s Alley. Launch into action, strike down the mischievous pins, amplify your score, and chain to gather impressive combos to become the ultimate bowling gladiator. Collect Upgrades! As your gain points level up and choose from over 40+ different upgrades included, perks, different balls and secondary weapons! SHOOT TO SCORE Each pin you obliterate racks up points to your scorecard. Send all ten pins in a formation flying and that's a Strike ! A pin or two short on your first shot? Follow it up with another roll to take down the stragglers and land a Spare ! Rank Up Combos: start out at a lowly “D” then hit those strikes and spares consistently and you’ll rapidly ascend the ranks. “S” rank bowlers will be rewarded with a hefty 5x multiplier on their score but only the fastest will have the tempo to keep it. CHALLENGE THE LEADERBOARD Get competitive and Submit your scorecard to the Global leaderboard and face off against other bowlers of Hell’s Alley worldwide. Watch your name fly up the ranks as you best your previous score with your new found skills. Or perhaps some friendly competition on the Friends leaderboard . Challenge your friends and rivals top score and claim the throne of the KingPin ! USE STRIKES TO UNLEASH POWERFUL ATTACKS Demonstrate your mastery by utilizing 4 powerful ball powers ! No one likes a gently rolled ball, fully charge and release at the perfect moment for maximum pin smashing satisfaction! More of a fly guy? Leap into the air and slam a fully charged plate of ball-splosion onto unsuspecting adversaries! and for the more precise ballers among you aim upwards and throw your ball to dispatch air borne targets. FACE A MISCHIEF OF PINS Put your balls on the line against a roster of 8 uniquely villainous pins ! Each designed with individual behaviors and abilities with their soul purpose bent on ruining your score! Some of the fiends you will be facing include... Flying rocket pins that will chase you down! Mortar pins that will relentlessly barrage your location! Joker pins that when struck down destroy your precious combos! With many more to discover as you climb the leaderboard!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Sparedevil is an arcade FPS with the graphic charm of classic '90s bowling alley animations. This single-player skirmish is all about skill, strategy, and speed as you aim to dominate the leaderboard and earn the crown as the Kingpin of Hell’s Alley. Launch into action, strike down the mischievous pins, amplify your score, and chain to gather impressive combos to become the ultimate bowling gladiator.

Collect Upgrades!

As your gain points level up and choose from over 40+ different upgrades included, perks, different balls and secondary weapons!

SHOOT TO SCORE

Each pin you obliterate racks up points to your scorecard. Send all ten pins in a formation flying and that's a Strike! A pin or two short on your first shot? Follow it up with another roll to take down the stragglers and land a Spare!

Rank Up Combos: start out at a lowly “D” then hit those strikes and spares consistently and you’ll rapidly ascend the ranks. “S” rank bowlers will be rewarded with a hefty 5x multiplier on their score but only the fastest will have the tempo to keep it.

CHALLENGE THE LEADERBOARD

Get competitive and Submit your scorecard to the Global leaderboard and face off against other bowlers of Hell’s Alley worldwide. Watch your name fly up the ranks as you best your previous score with your new found skills.

Or perhaps some friendly competition on the Friends leaderboard. Challenge your friends and rivals top score and claim the throne of the KingPin!

USE STRIKES TO UNLEASH POWERFUL ATTACKS

Demonstrate your mastery by utilizing 4 powerful ball powers! No one likes a gently rolled ball, fully charge and release at the perfect moment for maximum pin smashing satisfaction! More of a fly guy? Leap into the air and slam a fully charged plate of ball-splosion onto unsuspecting adversaries! and for the more precise ballers among you aim upwards and throw your ball to dispatch air borne targets.

  

FACE A MISCHIEF OF PINS

Put your balls on the line against a roster of 8 uniquely villainous pins! Each designed with individual behaviors and abilities with their soul purpose bent on ruining your score! Some of the fiends you will be facing include...

  • Flying rocket pins that will chase you down!

  • Mortar pins that will relentlessly barrage your location!

  • Joker pins that when struck down destroy your precious combos!
    With many more to discover as you climb the leaderboard!
